raw_posts.name: Scholé Learn by Building
raw_posts.tagline: Learning should be more than "click next"
raw_posts.description: Learn by building, on any website, with Scholé by your side. You can read about a tool, watch someone walk through it on YouTube, or ask ChatGPT to explain it. But you won’t properly learn until you build with it yourself. Learn Anywhere mode guides you through using any real tool directly on your screen, adapting tasks and giving visual hints. Everything you learn updates your Scholé knowledge graph and counts towards your lessons. Our thesis? Learn it well enough to use it.

raw_posts.name: Floot MCP
raw_posts.tagline: Build and ship web and mobile apps inside Claude or ChatGPT
raw_posts.description: Connect Floot to Claude or ChatGPT and build a full-stack app without leaving the chat. Floot gives your AI a ready-to-use workspace with a database, user logins, hosting, and a live URL - nothing to install or configure. Your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription does the thinking, so Floot doesn’t charge based on AI usage. When you’re ready, publish the same project to the web, iOS, and Android, then keep shipping updates from the same conversation.

raw_posts.name: NOAN
raw_posts.tagline: The fact layer for your AI agents
raw_posts.description: Your company has thousands of documents, but only one version of the truth. NOAN turns the facts your business has approved such as pricing, positioning, policies, products, customers, and more into a verified, versioned source of truth available through API and MCP. Connect any model, agent, or app and give them all the same company facts, instead of letting each AI interpret your documents differently.

raw_posts.name: minimi 2.0
raw_posts.tagline: AI cat that closes your open loops
raw_posts.description: minimi is personal intelligence that comes to you. raw_posts.name: CtrlOps 1.0
raw_posts.tagline: Your server. Audited, managed, and deployed with AI.
raw_posts.description: Do you actually know who has access to your servers right now? CtrlOps gives you a security hardening score across 25 checks, a PDF audit report, and fix commands for every issue found. See who can log into every server, revoke access from your whole fleet in one click, and assign any level of roles/access without touching the terminal. Every log file, found and searchable without SSH. Deploy any app from GitHub in minutes. 100% local. Your credentials never leave your machine.

raw_posts.name: Hookest
raw_posts.tagline: Your swipe file for viral video hooks
raw_posts.description: Hookest tracks the opening seconds of viral TikToks, Reels, and Shorts and makes them searchable with real performance data. Study what’s working in your niche, watch competitors, and bring saved hooks into Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini through MCP.

raw_posts.name: Bitrise Build Hub
raw_posts.tagline: GitHub Actions runners that build 2x faster for your agents
raw_posts.description: Coding agents push more code, so your CI runs more builds than ever. GitHub's runners are slow, so every extra build sits in the queue and your team waits with it. Bitrise Build Hub runs those builds on the newest Apple Silicon and high-core Linux instead: 54% faster on iOS, 31% on Android. PRs come back in minutes, and your app ships sooner. You keep GitHub Actions. Changing one line in your workflow is all it takes to run on the best runners made for mobile.

raw_posts.name: Maximem Synap
raw_posts.tagline: The fastest, most accurate memory layer for AI agents
raw_posts.description: Maximem Synap is memory and context infrastructure for AI agents, so every conversation does not start from zero. It is the fastest and most accurate memory system on public benchmarks, 92% on LongMemEval and 93.2% on Locomo, with sub-15ms P75 recall. It handles entity resolution, temporal reasoning, and multi-level scoping automatically, no vector database or ranker to tune. Native across 22 frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, and the Claude Agent SDK. Free tier, no credit card required.

raw_posts.name: Opaline
raw_posts.tagline: PostHog for team Claude Code and Codex sessions.
raw_posts.description: Team-wide, message-level analytics for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Track token cost, time, and skill usage for every single message across your team’s sessions. Catch every “You’re absolutely right” from Claude and every “I know, you f*cking idiot” from a frustrated teammate.

raw_posts.name: Autonomous Product Delivery
raw_posts.tagline: Discover, plan, build, ship, repeat. Product teams run it
raw_posts.description: AI coding agents made code fast; delivery still crawls, because coding is one seat in the product cycle. Autonomous Product Delivery runs the whole loop as one system on your real codebase. Ask a question, or let it suggest the next improvement on its own: The final piece in the loop, the new Discover Mode, researches your analytics, tickets, calls, and code, then the system plans, builds, verifies, and hands your engineers a review-ready PR. Every merge makes it smarter.
